checks: Verified original §5, equations (7)–(8), including its scope as a curved calibration rather than a bad-depth example.

For the uniform unit disk, radial integration gives E|X|²=1/2 and isotropy gives Sigma=I/4. At the centroid the optimizer is zero and f=1; every unit Euclidean direction then cuts at -1/2 and gives the segment complement 2π/3+sqrt(3)/4. For y≠0 the outward direction has threshold |y|−f(y)/2>−1/2 and strictly smaller mass, including when the threshold is at the upper support.

The covectors have covariance norm one, their positive equal-weight resultant vanishes, and the weighted old shifted margin is 1−f≥0, with equality at the unique source. All own cuts are proper and the rank-zero pure-base mass is M.

The chord length is sqrt(3), so dividing by ||u||=2 gives S_j=sqrt(3)/2, θ=1/3 and δ=sqrt(3)/2. The three omitted arcs of angle 2π/3 partition up to endpoints; the quadratic sum is 2||X||² from the isotropic three-direction outer products.
The density correction bracket is 1/(2π), which times δ cancels exactly the excess beta−2/3. The continuous covectors span the plane, so A is positive definite despite the curved boundary.

dependencies.hypotheses: Applied to the unit disk and its centroid to obtain E=M, optimizer zero, and E≤M at every interior mark; the standard boundary zero extension is explicit.
The three cap traces are proper, have positive coarea, share the sole deepest mark and satisfy the exact positive-weight balanced cover. These are regular singleton group data for its d=2 density.

overlap.comparison: Its general response formula does not provide an actual curved calibration with simultaneous cap criticality, positive definite Hessian and vanishing density.
Its obstruction assumes a free uncut facet; the disk has no facet and shows why that conclusion cannot be extended to all freely tested regular bodies.

readability: The excluded arc endpoints are the three shared chord endpoints on the circle, a null set. The claim is about maximum depth on the disk and its response density, not shape optimality.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The disk and the three covariance-unit active directions give an actual critical regular group with identically zero density almost everywhere.
